about.title: About
about.p1: Hello! I'm Romuald, a junior web developer passionate about creating modern, functional websites.
about.p2: Do you have a web project? I can transform it into a responsive, functional site tailored to your needs: custom build, improving an existing site, or fixing bugs.
about.p3: Independent, curious and continuously learning, I'm always ready to take on new challenges with enthusiasm.

spending.title: Spending Tracker
spending.desc: A finance management app to track income, expenses and balance in real time, built with React.

voyage.title: VoyageAI Landing Page
voyage.desc: Landing page made for a contest, presenting the concept of an intelligent travel assistant. It's a functional mockup focused on design and layout.

todo.title: Todo-App
todo.desc: A responsive React app for task management: add, delete and mark tasks as done. This project helped me practice state management with hooks and component composition.

form.title: Login form
form.desc: Simple authentication form built with HTML/CSS and server-side handling in PHP. This project helped me strengthen session handling and data validation.

gpi.title: IT asset management
gpi.desc: A Laravel application to manage an inventory of IT equipment. It includes CRUD features (assets, brands, suppliers). The system integrates authentication and user management.
